entities.name: Mehmed Alajbegović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mehmed Alajbegović was a Bosnian Muslim politician, lawyer and a government minister of the Independent State of Croatia, an Axis puppet state. He was executed for war crimes by Yugoslav authorities following the war.
